caption: The drawing depicts a long, high-necked dress with long sleeves, shown from the front. The dress appears to be a light, neutral color such as white, cream, or pale beige, and the illustration is done mainly in shades of gray and blue. The bodice of the dress is fitted and features blue decorative embroidery or embellishments on the chest. The waist is cinched, and the skirt is full and gathered, extending to the floor. Blue floral patterns and curving lines, possibly embroidery or printed designs, are distributed across the skirt and bodice, following a gentle diagonal sweep from the lower left side to the upper right. The cuffs and the edge of the skirt hem also have blue detailing. The background is plain and unadorned, and the artist has signed the drawing at the lower right corner with the name "Mary E. Humes" and the text "W.P.A. - VA."
title: Wedding Dress
